notes: The Arduino UNO WiFi Rev2 is not in the provided catalogue, so it is defined as a new part type; the GND next to AREF on the digital header is named GND.1.
Breadboard hole names follow the image's row labels: the upper half (rows f-j) is treated as bank 'b' in the catalogue naming, so holes are like 3b.g.

Circuit from image: pin 2 -> green wire -> column 3 (row g); 220 ohm resistor from column 3 to column 6 (row h); LED anode (bent/longer leg) in column 6, cathode in column 8; black wire from column 8 (row h) to GND.
LED polarity inferred from the bent (longer) leg being the anode.
Software steps (WiFiNINA access point sketch) are not part of the hardware graph. The built-in LED alternative is not modelled.
